title: Indexing the verifier’s seeds
statement: Let $V$ be a nonadaptive tester for Boolean-valued functions on inputs of length $n$, with proof length $\ell$ and $r$ query positions. The seed space of its verifier is equivalent to the set of integers from $0$ through one less than the size of that finite seed space.
hypotheses_covered: A PCPP system with Boolean alphabet, input length $n$, proof length $\ell$, and $r$ query positions
The verifier has a finite seed space
